title: Extension of pointed etale neighbourhoods from the generic point
statement: Let $D$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme], $K=k(D)$ and $\eta:\operatorname{Spec}K\to D$ its generic inclusion [def-sc-function-field]. Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field and $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. For every pointed etale neighbourhood $(W,w)$ of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], there is a pointed etale neighbourhood $(V,v)$ of $s\circ\eta$ and a morphism of pointed etale neighbourhoods $(V\times_D\operatorname{Spec}K,(v,s))\to(W,w)$ over $\operatorname{Spec}K$.

source.place: Tags 02GH, 01ZM, 07RP; generic counit argument of blueprint lem-sc-affine-generic-second, proof paragraph 3

proof.text: Restrict the etale neighbourhood W to an affine open U containing the image of its marking. Spec Omega has a single point, so the whole marking factors through U. The resulting W0 is etale, and its source and target are affine. Consequently its structure map is affine, quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and it is locally of finite presentation by etaleness.

At the generic point the local ring is the function field. Use the already proved source-library implementation Scheme.functionFieldCone and Scheme.isLimitFunctionFieldCone of the affine-neighbourhood limit: the index consists of nonempty affine opens of D, all containing the generic point. Each stage is Spec Gamma(D,U), its map to D is U.fromSpec, and Scheme.fromSpecFunctionField_eq_functionFieldCone_comp identifies every leg followed by this map with the generic inclusion. Reindex by the opposite of the order dual using orderDualEquivalence and opOpEquivalence, and whisker the limit cone. Affine stages are qcqs and the transition maps between them are affine.

Apply only clause (1), object descent, of etale_finite_data_descent to W0 over this limit. Obtain a stage i, an etale finite-presentation V over Spec Gamma(D,i), and an isomorphism alpha from its generic fibre to W0. Compose the structure morphism of V with j = i.fromSpec to obtain an etale morphism q : V -> D.

Write p for the limit leg at i and eta for the generic inclusion, so p followed by j is eta. Let z be the marking of W0 followed by alpha inverse, and let v = z followed by the first pullback projection to V. Since alpha is over Spec K, z followed by the second projection is s. The pullback equation gives v followed by q = s followed by eta. Form the pointed neighbourhood b=(V,v). Define g : V x_D Spec K -> V x_(Spec Gamma(D,i)) Spec K from the two projections; its compatibility equation follows by cancellation of the monomorphism j. The desired underlying morphism is g followed by alpha followed by U -> W. It is over Spec K. Both projections show that the canonical marking of the base change of b followed by g is z. Composing with alpha cancels alpha inverse and recovers the original marking. Thus the underlying map defines a morphism of pointed neighbourhoods.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01ZM and 07RP, with Tags 0GWT and 01YW for the affine-neighbourhood limit; blueprint lem-sc-affine-generic-second paragraph 3. Lean implementation uses the proved WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.FunctionFieldLimit, existing etale_finite_data_descent object clause, and pullback equations.

theorem exists_hom_generic_baseChangeNbhd
    (D : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral D]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec D.functionField)
    (d : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.Elements) :

      (s ≫ D.fromSpecFunctionField) ⟨s, rfl⟩).obj c ⟶ d)
